Synopsis: The player finds a book on necromancy - from one of the Red Wizards of Thay. Once read, the book will be bound to whoever tried to read it. Some origins will demand you let them read it, while others will want the book burned. If you read the book, you'll hear strange, distant whispers. The more you read, the stronger the voices will become, and the greater the chance that you'll be driven mad. context: You have uncovered a locked Red Wizards tome, The Necromancy of Thay: its cover has amethyst “eyes” and an oval recess instead of a visible keyhole. The book is magically bound so that anyone who reads it becomes its owner, and reading summons distant whispers that grow stronger with more study and can eventually drive the reader mad. Some character origins react by demanding the book be read or destroyed; in this scene the player chooses to drop the tome and prepare to destroy it. Off‑screen companions voice their positions—Lae’zel condemns anyone who opens it, Shadowheart is curious but cautious, Karlach warns against it, Astarion offers to take it (and later obsesses over studying it at camp), and Wyll urges it be secured or removed. There are also later, separate interactions tied to carrying the unread book (seances with Mystic Carrion, links to other necromantic codices), but those occur outside this exchange.
